text:
noah: Heads-up: experiment kickoff for pricing page + webinar registration. Need final call on tier labels + where to surface the cost calculator. Also routing for inbound post-webinar.

anya: I can lead copy for tier labels. My shortlist: "Core / Growth / Enterprise" and "Individual / Team / Organization". I prefer Individual/Team/Organization because it's less jargon-y. Will write 2-line descriptors for each.

kevin: Ops note: routing wise we should capture company_employee_range instead of exact headcount to simplify. I propose buckets: <50, 50-500, >500. >500 or selecting Organization -> enterprise queue. Add a checkbox for "I need private deployment (VPC/on-prem)" to flag for SOC review.

sofia: I'll handle the FAQ edits. Primary FAQ bullets I plan to update: billing cadence, reserved capacity vs hosted, data residency, SLAs, and trial credit expiry. Will include short links to the docs site.

ops-bot: AB experiment registered: pricing_experiment_2026_07_19 id=px_4211 | variants: A (calc above CTA) / B (calc below CTA) | metrics: pricing_page_reg_rate, calc_clicks, postreg_demo_ops

noah: Timing: 14-day test starting Monday. Primary KPI = pricing_page_reg_rate. Secondary KPI = number of follow-up demo requests in 30 days. Also we need a 2-slide benchmark snapshot (latency & cost per 100k tokens vs common hosted competitors) for the webinar.

anya: I'll post microcopy in #docs by tomorrow noon for review. Will include SEO-friendly headings so server-side variant swap doesn't hurt indexing.

kevin: Implementation detail: server-side variant mapping will use header X-Exp: px_4211=A|B so marketing can share stable preview links. Any objections?

sofia: No objections. Also coordinating with CS to publish a 1-page playbook: suggested responses, escalation path, and common cost questions.

ops-bot: Event spec: https://redwood.internal/px/px_4211/spec (internal) | GTM: exp=px_4211, var=A|B, calc_visible=true|false

noah: For webinar gating, let's add two fields: interest_tier (Individual/Team/Organization) and primary_workload (chat / embeddings / retrieval / other). Use those to route leads.

kevin: I'll add the webhook payload example to the PR:
```
POST /v1/lead-router
{
  "interest_tier": "string",
  "company_bucket": "string",
  "primary_workload": "string",
  "private_deploy": "boolean"
}
```
Will implement 3 retries and alert on DLQ.

anya: Quick Q: Should calculator be interactive (editable params) or a static estimator? Interactive is more engaging but might increase complexity for the experiment.

noah: Start with a lightweight interactive (tokens per month, avg seq len, embedding ops toggle). Keep validation light. If conversion lifts, we'll invest in richer modeling.

sofia: I'll draft the FAQ snippets and CS playbook this afternoon and tag everyone for quick feedback.

noah: Thanks team. Check-in on Monday 9am PT. Please attach copy + heatmap screenshots before then.
